newsitem.title: JAPAN: NCB says has no plans to reduce capital.
newsitem.headline: NCB says has no plans to reduce capital.

text.p: Nippon Credit Bank Ltd said on Thursday it has no plans to reduce its capital. The bank also said it believes its restructuring measures have been accepted by financial markets.
"There is no plan to reduce the bank's capital, as rumoured," it said in a statement.
There was vague market talk on Wednesday that the bank would further reduce the amount of its capital, but a spokesman for NCB denied the rumour.

The bank on Tuesday announced restructuring measures aimed at restoring its financial health. It said it hoped the measures, which included halting overseas operations, would boost its capital by 300 billion yen.
In Thursday's statement it said it had not yet decided details on issuing new shares.

Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka said on Tuesday that the ministry had asked the Bank of Japan and a special body administering a fund to wind up failed finance firms for permission to use the fund to buy preferred stock to be issued by NCB.
